decision.observation: 9 mph, gear 1, timer 59:59.000, dots pale. Big camera cut to a wide open grass field: the car sits on grass with a LARGE BOULDER immediately ahead-right of its nose, more boulders scattered left, and a gravel road running across the frame up top beside the lake and autumn trees. A gravel strip also visible along the bottom edge.
decision.hypothesis: The car is aimed straight at a boulder a car-length away, so plain throttle would hit it. The road lies up-frame; steering left should clear the boulder on its left side while still trending toward the road junction at upper-left.
decision.memory: New landmark: broad open grass meadow with scattered boulders, a lake, and a gravel road crossing the top of the frame plus a gravel strip at bottom edge — likely a junction/clearing beyond the birch straight. Camera cut landed the car on grass facing a boulder.
